purpose: Calibrate public-safety vendor role fit using verified transition signals after hard eligibility and requirement matching. These points are evidence-prioritization aids, not interview probabilities.

weight_scale.4: primary evidence for this role family

method.rule: A transition signal may improve prioritization but may never override a hard requirement or convert transferable experience into direct vendor, SaaS, sales, administration, or implementation experience.

protected_data_policy.storage_rule: Do not store self-identification answers in job-fit records, public repositories, application notes, or outcome analytics.
protected_data_policy.application_default: When an optional pre-employment demographic survey offers a decline option and Troy prefers privacy, select the explicit decline or I-do-not-wish-to-answer option. Never state that no disability exists if that would be untrue.
protected_data_policy.accommodation_rule: Request an application or interview accommodation only when needed and disclose the functional accommodation required, not an unnecessary diagnosis or rating.
exceptions: A separately approved and documented federal Schedule A or veterans-preference application path
A disability-targeted recruiting program Troy affirmatively chooses to use
A required accommodation for the application or interview process

former_sworn_public_safety.verified_evidence: 25 years of sworn Minnesota law-enforcement service
former_sworn_public_safety.claim_boundary: Agency credibility and operational workflow knowledge; not vendor employment or SaaS account ownership.

detective_investigator.verified_evidence: Detective rotations in 2010-2011 and 2016-2021, including electronic-crimes and multi-agency task-force work
detective_investigator.claim_boundary: Supports investigative discovery, workflow translation, case communication, and stakeholder coordination; not formal consulting tenure.

crime_scene_unit.claim_boundary: Physical evidence collection, scene documentation, and chain of custody; not a full-time crime-lab position.

digital_forensic_examiner.verified_evidence: 5.5 years of electronic-crimes and digital-forensic work
digital_forensic_examiner.claim_boundary: Direct examiner and agency-user expertise; not vendor-side product implementation or software engineering.

adult_instructor_and_fto.verified_evidence: Field Training Officer experience and 18 years of concurrent adjunct teaching
adult_instructor_and_fto.claim_boundary: Supports training, enablement, adoption, workshops, and technical translation; not an automatic claim of SaaS customer ownership.

agency_side_technology_project.verified_evidence: Agency-side Genetec AutoVu ALPR evaluation, acquisition, implementation, workflow, and grant-program involvement
agency_side_technology_project.claim_boundary: Describe as agency-side project and adoption experience, never vendor-side implementation employment.

cad_rms_end_user.verified_evidence: Extensive patrol and detective use of TriTech Inform CAD/mapping and CentralSquare Records Enterprise/field-reporting workflows
cad_rms_end_user.claim_boundary: Do not claim CAD/RMS administration, configuration, interface engineering, or implementation ownership.

axon_connected_workflow_end_user.verified_evidence: Axon Body 3 and Fleet 3 evidence capture connected to Axon Evidence (Evidence.com) review, management, retrieval, and case use
axon_connected_workflow_end_user.claim_boundary: Do not claim Evidence.com administration, retention-policy configuration, system ownership, or implementation of Axon DFR.

us_army_veteran.verified_evidence: U.S. Army, 8 years 3 months, honorably discharged
us_army_veteran.claim_boundary: Always identify as veteran. Do not use protected-veteran or VEVRAA language without separate verification.

military_police_95b.verified_evidence: MN Army National Guard, MOS 95B Military Police, October 1995-October 1998
military_police_95b.claim_boundary: Supports public-safety mission familiarity and field operations; do not infer civilian investigative credentials or current certification.

combat_arms_11b_19k.verified_evidence: Army Reserve 11B Infantry and Active Duty 19K Armor service
combat_arms_11b_19k.claim_boundary: Translate only to mission execution, safety, accountability, adaptability, and field operations when the posting values them; no generic technical or sales bonus.

motor_transport_88m.verified_evidence: MN Army National Guard, MOS 88M Motor Transport, April 1994-April 1995
motor_transport_88m.claim_boundary: Use only for fleet, deployment, logistics, equipment-accountability, or field-operations relevance.

A.definition: Official public evidence of multiple relevant former-practitioner or veteran transition paths into the target role families.

B.definition: Official evidence of at least one relevant transition path or a strong veteran/public-safety hiring program, but role-family evidence is narrower.

C.definition: Candidate product/domain fit only; no verified incumbent transition evidence yet.

hard_gap_controls.rule: Exclude unless the posting explicitly permits Troy's approved residence and work arrangement.
Exclude when a currently held credential is mandatory and not verified.
Agency-side rollout and workflow adoption remain transferable; do not relabel them as vendor-side SaaS implementations.
Public-safety credibility and real-estate sales do not erase a hard quota or enterprise-sales requirement.
Exclude or mark stretch when hands-on engineering depth is mandatory.
End-user experience is direct user evidence, not administration or configuration.
DFR mission fit does not establish UAS flight experience or Part 107 certification.
Manager titles remain viable only when the work is individual-contributor implementation, program, or customer delivery unless direct reports are not required.
Apply Troy's stated travel and compensation preferences after role fit, and flag exceptions explicitly.

fit_zones.direct: Core requirements are met with direct evidence; transition signals explain domain advantage.
fit_zones.near: Core outcome is credible with mostly direct evidence and bounded transferable gaps.
fit_zones.targeted_stretch: One material but learnable gap remains; pathway evidence and adjacent experience justify a selective application.
fit_zones.no_go: A hard block or multiple major gaps remain; transition identity cannot rescue the fit.
